ProductCreate.description:
A product the user confirmed on the label-confirm screen, or typed by hand.

**The server does all nutrient arithmetic; the client only transcribes what the pack
prints and records the user's explicit choices.** The stored per-100 g values are:

1. `nutrients` as sent, with `sodium_mg` multiplied by 1000 when `sodium_unit` is `g`;
2. then, when `basis` is `per_serving`, every value x 100 / `serving_size_g`;
3. then, for a scan save, values the draft holds back are set to null unless confirmed
   (`confirmed_fields`, below);
4. then the engine's plausibility check runs on exactly the values that will be stored
   (422 `implausible_value`), including `serving_size_g` only when it will be stored or
   used for conversion. Values are never rounded.

With `scan_id` the values come from that label scan (source `label`, the extraction
confidence, which user edits never raise); without it the entry is manual (source
`user`, confidence 1.0, values taken as typed). For a scan save the server re-runs its
current normaliser on the stored raw extraction (R19), so the warnings it applies can be
stricter than the draft the client showed; scans without a stored raw extraction use the
stored draft. Text keeps its script (Devanagari stays Devanagari); only surrounding
whitespace is trimmed and blank items are dropped.

**Clients do not re-derive the rules below: render `ProductDraft.confirm` (R21), which
the server computes with the same helpers that enforce them.** A body that honours the
hints is stored in full; one that ignores them is a 422 or stores null for each field it
did not confirm.

Every request counts toward the account's daily `product_creates` limit (429
`rate_limited`), including requests rejected with 422, so a client should fix the body
before retrying rather than resend it.

Scan-save rules (422 `validation_error` with `details.fields` naming the field):
- `category` and `basis` are always required (the user must pick them; nothing defaults).
- (R19) `sodium_unit` must be `mg` or `g` (not null) whenever the draft has ANY
  `unit_unconfirmed:*.sodium_mg` or `sodium_unit_suspect:*.sodium_mg` warning (either
  column, whichever `basis` is chosen; `confirm.columns.*.sodium_unit_required`) and
  `nutrients.sodium_mg` is not null; else 422 `["body.sodium_unit"]`. Listing `sodium_mg`
  in `confirmed_fields` never stands in for the unit. A non-null unit confirms sodium.
- (R19) With `basis` `per_serving`, or whenever the draft was `derived_from_serving`
  (with or without `basis_mismatch`), every nutrient is stored only if `confirmed_fields`
  contains `serving_size_g` (the user checked the serving size); otherwise all are
  stored null and the serving size is neither used nor checked.
- (R18) The stored `serving_size_g` is the sent value only if `confirmed_fields` contains
  `serving_size_g`; otherwise it is stored null (unknown) and the engine falls back to
  per-100 g. A manual entry (no `scan_id`) stores the serving size as typed.
- On a `basis_mismatch` draft the explicit `basis` confirms the values sent. (R19) An
  upper-bound ("<X") protein or fibre on EITHER printed column is stored only if listed
  in `confirmed_fields`, and a unit-less sodium still needs `sodium_unit`.

confirmed_fields.description: Scan saves only: what the user explicitly confirmed. A nutrient the draft lists in `engine_withheld`, or an upper-bound ("<0.1 g") protein or fibre on either printed column (R19), is stored only when listed here, else null. `serving_size_g` confirms the serving size and is required for any value of a per-serving save or a `derived_from_serving` draft to be stored (R19); an unconfirmed scanned serving size is stored as null (R18). Listing `sodium_mg` never replaces `sodium_unit`.
confirmed_fields.title: Confirmed Fields

For a scan save it is used for conversion and stored only when `confirmed_fields` lists it (R18); otherwise it is stored as null, and is not plausibility-checked because it is neither stored nor used (R19). A manual entry stores it as typed.
serving_size_g.title: Serving Size G

sodium_unit.description: The unit of `nutrients.sodium_mg`: null means mg (the unit is printed, or this is a manual entry in mg). `g` is converted to mg by the server. Send the user's explicit pick (`mg` or `g`, never null) whenever the scan draft has any `unit_unconfirmed:*.sodium_mg` or `sodium_unit_suspect:*.sodium_mg` warning (either column, whatever the basis; `sodium_unit_required`) and sodium is not null, else 422 `body.sodium_unit` (R19). A non-null unit confirms sodium; `confirmed_fields` never replaces it.

delete.description:
Permanently erase the caller's account (DPDP erasure, F11).

Order: storage objects (label photos; voice audio is never stored), then every
account-owned row in one transaction (contributed products stay with no owner), then the
Supabase auth user. The row erasure also writes a tombstone (ruling D1/B1): until it is
purged (7 days), the caller's still-valid token gets 401 `auth_invalid` everywhere else.
Idempotent: calling it again returns 204 (at most 5 calls a day, then 429). On 503
`deletion_incomplete`, retry: completed steps are skipped. Depends on `current_account`
(not `current_account_row`) so a repeat call never re-creates the account row.

How SmartNutri scores products: every rule's live thresholds and their sources.

post.description:
Answer a spoken question about one product for one family member.

Send exactly one of `product_id` (our catalogue) or `barcode` (Open Food Facts). Audio:
at most 30 s and 5 MB; m4a/AAC, WAV, WebM, Ogg or mp3, detected from the bytes. The
verdict comes only from the rules engine; `answer` starts with it. Needs the
`ai_processing` consent. Rate-limited per account per day (`rate_limited_voice`).

No voice audio is stored: the spoken answer comes back inline as base64 mp3
(`audio_base64`), or null when it would be over about 1 MB (show the text answer).

Off by default: while the server setting `VOICE_ENABLED` is false, every call answers
503 `ai_unavailable` (clients show the same "voice unavailable" message as for an outage).
